# Golden C side of the ifcs-shim guard differential (crates/ifcs-shim/tests/differential.rs): per script of the
# comparison (the 16 of tests/corpus and the 400 generated by generate(seed), seeds 0..399, generator pinned by
# GENERATED_DIGEST a4457383ef108f57), the trace that tests/c/guard_harness.c prints when it drives the C library
# libsai-teralynx-shim.so (shim.c + ifcs_guard.c, UNMODIFIED, the Makefile's flags). One line per script: the script's
# FNV-1a 64 ("input"), the trace's line count, byte count and FNV-1a 64; the full trace (each line prefixed by "|")
# for the 16 corpus scripts (all of them, incl. allones-overflow.txt, the one with the deliberate difference).
# The generated scripts are regenerated by the test from the pinned generator (input digest per script checked).
# The Rust shim is compared with this golden by the same rules as with the live C library: equal, but for the one
# allowed difference (compare_allowing_text_cap: 6 trace lines over the whole set, ALLOWED_LINES, all in
# allones-overflow.txt; allowed only against the stored text). NOT to be regenerated from the Rust output.
# Captured 2026-11-26 from these C files (sha256):
#   bff275c19ba3649fd1783f5f2b55ebf0e462c0238ff6d87ff946152efdfa4343  ai_re/nix/packages/sai-teralynx/src/shim.c
#   17ba238fafcb2181b9e7c9399b9ce966e0cb09d55b377eeb935c5b958c2ed2fb  ai_re/nix/packages/sai-teralynx/src/ifcs_guard.c
#   1a272da345fe2c1e399491900cc38991fdbae6e88c073eca671fdc7bf1ad1337  rust/sai/crates/ifcs-shim/tests/c/guard_harness.c
# Command (the C library only; rust/sai, devenv; IFCS_SHIM_LIB = this tree's release cdylib, needed by the same test):
#   IFCS_SHIM_DIFF_REQUIRE=1 IFCS_SHIM_LIB=<release>/libsai_teralynx_shim.so IFCS_SHIM_CAPTURE=<file> \
#     cargo test --release -p ifcs-shim --test differential rust_shim_equals_the_c_shim
# Live == golden: the same test (without IFCS_SHIM_CAPTURE) asserts for every script that the live C trace equals the
# golden (digest and, where stored, text) and prints "ifcs-shim live == golden: 416 C traces equal the golden".
# Negative control: the_guard_golden_comparison_reports_a_changed_golden. Rust vs golden (no C needed):
# rust_shim_equals_the_golden_of_the_c_guard.
